0915.method: version 1: base forecast recalibrated with the daily news signal of this session and the 2 before (12 inputs); calibrators frozen: fitted on the sessions to 2026-09-30

DVine_1d.note: base: issued at the previous close; news: re-issued at 09:15 with the news (the open is not used)

marks.method: v1: daily news of this session and the 2 before; v2: v1 + driver news at 15-minute resolution up to 15 minutes before the mark

hour.note: the hour forecast issued at its hour, re-adjusted with the news at the mark; levels never inside the hour's high / low so far

day.note: the 10:15 re-issue of the day's high / low, re-adjusted with the news at the mark; levels never inside the day's high / low so far
